base_model: E, exact archived32-subcell mixtures/nodes/weights/support, no recut or refit
correction: M_bj += a0+a1*(native_node_g-r-.30), all three bands; means_ij -= correction; all weights/labels/support unchanged
folds: fixed SHA256(native_id,seed), alternating within each observed-color stratum of eligible M5; other M5 parent identities hash%2; every prediction uses opposite training fold
calibration_parent: M5 E-supported existing lower_MS or turnoff, all other primary parents retained for prediction/status
common_draws: Reuse v7 whole-parent multiplicities for all new cohorts. New fixed-seed independent Gaussian system-mu draws with sigma from frozen distance-draw spread; one draw/system/replicate shared across all methods. Preserve original v7 reference vectors and scores separately. This matches the declared Gaussian system-mu likelihood exactly.

fit.objective: joint MAP R(mu)*product_i p_i^cal(mu); theta0=a0+mu-mu_ref factorizes likelihood and one R; optimize(theta0,a1), mu_MAP=mu_ref; bootstrap a0=theta0_boot-delta_mu_M5
fit.prior: flat a0/a1, one Gaussian system reference only; no per-star R, no added scatter
fit.solver: unbounded L-BFGS-B, analytic gradient; six fixed numerical starts, not six models
fit.bootstrap_starts: point optimum and zero; retain best objective and solver/curvature/mode diagnostics

scoring.M5: conditional on shared system reference: point forecasts at mu_ref; no independent reference-kernel convolution. Bootstrap ref shifts same reference and calibrated intercept, hence cancellation for calibrated PDF. Reference-CDF diagnostic integrates the coupled reference/fit draws; original E/QRF use their same shared draw. Zero QRF density retained as -inf with explicit counts, never floor.
scoring.external: point-parameter forecasts convolved once with independent target Gaussian mu kernel. Bootstrap parameters refitted with common M5 shifts; target reference draws shared across methods. Separately empirical bootstrap-parameter-mixture prediction, one common parameter index for all target members, independent target kernel once; mixture evaluation CIs condition on fitted calibration ensemble and resample target members/reference.
scoring.legacy: all v7 scores/definitions preserved; new conditional M5 scores are a separately named estimand
scoring.CRPS: same modulus coordinate and respective explicit reference convention, positive loss; no Gaussian approximation of mixture/QRF

extrapolation.training_range: actual observed native g-r min/max of each training fold or full eligible M5; compute node posterior mass outside unchanged weights

geometry.metric: exact nearest original adjacent segment in native gr/rz with full negative shared-r covariance; preserve frozen E support
geometry.interpretation: whitened tangent residual zero by definition for an interior nearest projection; report endpoints separately and physical perpendicular residual/error; no fixed-Mg projection used as orthogonal-color evidence

prescreen_excluded.NGC362: published project v3.2 distance outcomes, not an unused independent system

independent.history: NGC1851 prior availability-only empty admissions; whole-project exposed source/fit/validation IDs must be audited. NGC5053 proposed only, roles/coverage to be audited before predictions.
independent.choice: prioritize nearest M5 native passband/FeH/age overlap and clean history/independent kinematic reference; at most one evaluation after full freeze and gate
independent.gate: M5 cross-prediction both phase |bias|<=.10, combined calibration-set paired logscore95lo>0 and CRPS95hi<0 versus E, reduced phase gap and W68 ratio<=1.5; at least one original external system has both phase target met, combined paired scores improve and W68 ratio<=1.5. Require eligible candidate and no exposed prediction IDs; otherwise no independent evaluation.

sky: all old sky images unchanged, selected B5-10/G10-20/R20-100, .3deg/5deg and fixed gain
